title: A proposed gold pattern hit matches when the named heuristic fires
description:
As an eval author, I want a raw pattern gold case to match when the named YAML heuristic fires on overlapping evidence, so that we can grade the rulebook before classification.

Feature: raw pattern hit match

  Scenario: Import heuristic fires
    Given a positive case for pattern database_connection on app.ts line 10
    And the file imports pg
    When I score raw pattern hits
    Then the case is matched

  Scenario: Heuristic does not fire
    Given a positive case for pattern external_api_call on client.py line 44
    And no third-party HTTP or import heuristic fires there
    When I score raw pattern hits
    Then the case is not matched
